data.text: Luke, I care about getting our neighbors treatment, but before we commit everyone’s catch, can you share the clinic’s appeal and confirm that $60,000 is needed today? We could sustainably catch 10 tons each—including you—and raise $50,000 without reducing next month’s stock. Could village donations or an advance cover the remaining $10,000? If the urgent shortfall is verified and there’s no other funding, I’m open to a one-time 60-ton total, shared fairly, with everyone agreeing to the 30-ton recovery cap next month. We should pay the clinic directly and keep the contributions transparent.
